items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: remember one fella still playing, his name is Manuel Cruz. They had some other fellas, but they're not, uh, they're not like in it like I am.

ctx.x: Um, were there any other, uh, jazz musicians, that is the musicians that later became jazz musicians in your orchestra or band at school? Do you remember who else was in there, anybody else? Maybe some of the older kids too, or different ones who had become musicians?
Well, it really built that out, because remember one fella still playing, his name is Manuel Cruz. They had some other fellas, but they're not, uh, they're not like in it like I am.
Oh, by the way, is Manuel Cruz still around town? Yeah, he is. I haven't seen him for a long time, he used to play clarinet and play some trumpet too.
